source: 2 Source Matrix by dusborne; Soundboard (shinid:125888) Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel (14 inch 16 track Master Reels @ 15ips) -> Dat (44.1k); Transfer Info: Dat -> Pro Tools -> Samplitude Professional v10.02 -> FLAC; and Audience (shinid:5250) Source: MR*> 2 reels> cass>SB Live!>.wav>.shn>CD-R. seed disks provided by eurodead.net; SHN Conversion by mvernon54@home.com

ai_review.summary: A superb Europe ’72 matrix capture with crystal‑clear mix and a smoking Dark Star → Sugar Magnolia run.
ai_review.review: The recording is a professionally mastered matrix that balances the board clarity with audience ambience, giving listeners distinct left‑right placement of Pigpen’s organ and Keith’s piano. Musically the show is tight and energetic, highlighted by an hour‑long Dark Star > Sugar Magnolia > Caution sequence and standout performances from Jerry, the “Pig” tunes, and Bill on drums.

ai_rating.rationale: All six detailed reviews award five stars, praising both the exceptional Europe‑72 performance and the excellent matrix sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, commercial‑release level mix with clear separation of organ (left) and piano (right); audience source adds natural ambience; no reported dropouts or muddiness.

standout_songs: Dark Star > Sugar Magnolia > Caution (hour‑long jam)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical Europe ’72 set – tight playing throughout with seamless transitions, especially the monumental Dark Star → Sugar Magnolia segue.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s tone is described as amazing and he’s in fine form throughout.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's piano is crystal‑clear on the right channel; Pigpen’s organ is prominent on the left, both highlighted by the mix.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann praised as a workhorse laying down the beat solidly (Mickey absent).
